title: AI Inline Actions Enhancement (Summarize)
description: Add 'summarize' rewrite variant to the AI prompt policy and update BubbleToolbar with improved ARIA accessibility
action: In editorAIPromptPolicy.ts: Add 'summarize' to the EditorAIRewriteVariant union type ('polish' | 'simplify' | 'expand' | 'formal' | 'casual' | 'summarize'). Add a new RewriteLabelKey type for 'summarize'. Add { id: 'summarize', labelKey: 'summarize' } to the REWRITE_OPTIONS array. Add summarize rewriteInstructions in both zh and en PromptCatalogs with instructions: 'Condense the selected text to its core meaning, keeping key information while reducing word count by approximately 50%. Preserve the original tone and intent.' Add 'summarize' to the buildEditorAIPayload function's rewrite variant handling. In BubbleToolbar.tsx: Add role='toolbar' attribute to the toolbar container div. Add aria-label='Formatting toolbar' to the container. Ensure all buttons have aria-label attributes.

criteria: editorAIPromptPolicy.ts contains 'summarize' in zh PromptCatalog rewriteInstructions
editorAIPromptPolicy.ts contains 'summarize' in en PromptCatalog rewriteInstructions
convergence.verification: Run npx vitest run. Verify BubbleToolbar tests pass. Check that 'summarize' option appears in REWRITE_OPTIONS.
convergence.definition_of_done: Summarize variant available as AI rewrite option, BubbleToolbar has proper ARIA role

files.change: Add 'summarize' to union type, add to REWRITE_OPTIONS array, add rewriteInstructions for summarize in zh and en catalogs
Add role='toolbar' and aria-label='Formatting toolbar' to the main container div

implementation: In editorAIPromptPolicy.ts: add 'summarize' to EditorAIRewriteVariant union type: 'polish' | 'simplify' | 'expand' | 'formal' | 'casual' | 'summarize'
In editorAIPromptPolicy.ts: add { id: 'summarize' as EditorAIRewriteVariant, labelKey: 'summarize' as RewriteLabelKey } to REWRITE_OPTIONS array
In editorAIPromptPolicy.ts zh catalog: add summarize rewriteInstructions: '将选中文本精简为核心含义，保留关键信息的同时将字数减少约50%。保持原有的语气和意图。'

In editorAIPromptPolicy.ts en catalog: add summarize rewriteInstructions: 'Condense the selected text to its core meaning, keeping key information while reducing word count by approximately 50%. Preserve the original tone and intent.'
In BubbleToolbar.tsx: add role='toolbar' and aria-label='Formatting toolbar' to the outermost toolbar container div
Ensure all button elements in BubbleToolbar have aria-label attributes
Run: npx vitest run to verify no regressions

reference.pattern: Existing rewrite variant pattern (polish, simplify, expand, formal, casual)
reference.examples: See how 'expand' variant is defined in REWRITE_OPTIONS and PromptCatalog

rationale.chosen_approach: Extend existing rewrite variant system — summarize is a natural addition to the existing 5 variants
decision_factors: Locked decision: AI actions via BubbleToolbar (context.md #2)
Existing prompt policy handles all rewrite variants uniformly
rationale.tradeoffs: Adds one more option to the rewrite menu — may need UI grouping if more variants added later

risks: Summarize prompt quality depends on LLM — mitigated by clear instructions in both languages
